question: After continuation scheduling is fixed and deployed proof is supplied, should a full exact-review lane cap all background review lanes at 16 workers when congested and 4 when saturated, including known degraded or stalled handoff states?
rationale: The thresholds and inclusion of stalled handoff states intentionally trade broad-review throughput for exact-review backlog recovery; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the production capacity policy.

options.title: Approve staged 16/4 policy
options.body: Accept the proposed thresholds and degraded/stalled behavior after continuation parity and deployed workflow proof demonstrate the operational effect.

options.title: Throttle healthy states only
options.body: Restrict throttling to healthy handoff states until production data shows that reducing background work helps degraded or stalled queues recover.

options.title: Pause adaptive throttling
options.body: Keep existing scheduling unchanged until maintainers choose thresholds from measured fleet behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve staged 16/4 policy
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed thresholds and degraded/stalled behavior after continuation parity and deployed workflow proof demonstrate the operational effect.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns repository-wide production worker allocation and workflow rollout policy.
